description: Seven lights circling on black, folded into a kaleidoscope that bursts on every beat, with a click track and the clock burned into the corner. Every kind of node in one stream: process, Python function, Slang shader, a generated subgraph, a stream placed as a subgraph, variables, a loop through Previous Value, and a body of its own drawn on the kaleidoscope's card.
name: Pulse Stage
